subject: how to extract param estimates from ubms fitted model object ?

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: how to extract param estimates from ubms fitted model object ?
parts:
Dear all,

I want to fit a simple occupancy model with package ubms (which, you remember, is the Bayesian 'sister package' of unmarked) and then save the point estimates, along with posterior SD and 95% CRIs. Does anybody know how I can extract this information ?

With an unmarked fit I would do this:
tmp <- summary(fm)
and then I can easily get what I want from the object 'tmp'. But this doesn't seem to work with ubms.

Thanks for any insight.

Best regards  --- Marc

messages.author: 247b990d236a7af6
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] how to extract param estimates from ubms fitted model object ?
parts:
I found the following:  https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ubms/vignettes/ubms.html#extracting-individual-parameters.

Using the example in the documentation

> (summary.state <- summary(fm, "state"))
                 mean    se_mean       sd      2.5%        25%        50%
(Intercept)  3.121541 0.09999626 1.325142  1.165798  2.2413949  2.8707931
cov1        -0.285168 0.05953196 0.728442 -2.054133 -0.6343958 -0.1720614
                  75%    97.5%    n_eff     Rhat
(Intercept) 3.7622820 6.430284 175.6133 1.004542
cov1        0.1994098 0.821368 149.7234 1.005578
> (summary.det <- summary(fm, "det"))
                 mean   se_mean        sd      2.5%       25%       50%
(Intercept) -1.816322 0.0112124 0.1830802 -2.153593 -1.937672 -1.821083
                  75%     97.5%    n_eff     Rhat

>
